title: Environmental Domain Score
short_description: IMED provides a national measure of cumulative environmental disadvantage across England using eight environmental indicators. These indicators were grouped and summed to form sub domains, capturing different aspects of environmental stress, for example, climate risk burden, pollution burden etc. The domain score integrates multiple environmental sub-domains into a thematic overall domain score for the whole of England.
description: Composite measure of cumulative environmental disadvantage across England combining multiple environmental sub-domains into a single continuous score.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates greater cumulative environmental disadvantage
methodology_summary: Composite score derived from climate, pollution and nature sub-domains.

title: Environmental Domain Decile
short_description: National decile of the IMED environmental domain.
description: National decile classification of the Environmental Domain Score, enabling comparison of relative environmental disadvantage across England.
higher_values_indicate: Deciles sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates greater environmental disadvantage
methodology_summary: Environmental Domain Score converted into national deciles.

title: Population-weighted Environmental Domain Decile (100 m)
short_description: Population-weighted national IMED deciles at 100 m.
description: Population-weighted version of the Environmental Domain Decile designed to reflect where people live rather than land area.
higher_values_indicate: Deciles sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates greater environmental disadvantage
methodology_summary: Population-weighted derivative of the Environmental Domain Decile.

title: Population-weighted Environmental Domain Decile (LSOA)
short_description: Population-weighted IMED deciles aggregated to LSOAs.
description: Population-weighted Environmental Domain Deciles aggregated to Lower Layer Super Output Areas for reporting and comparison with administrative geographies.
higher_values_indicate: Deciles sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates greater environmental disadvantage
methodology_summary: Population-weighted deciles aggregated to LSOA geography.

title: Climate Risk Burden
description: Combines flood risk from rivers and sea, surface water flooding and projected summer heat into a single climate risk burden score.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates greater climate-related environmental disadvantage
methodology_summary: Direct summation of aligned climate indicators.

title: Nature Deficit Burden
short_description: Composite measure of nature-related environmental disadvantage.
description: Combines quality habitat deficit and lack of access to greenspace into a single nature deficit burden score.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates greater nature-related environmental disadvantage
methodology_summary: Direct summation of aligned nature indicators.

title: Pollution Burden
description: Combines PM2.5, nitrogen dioxide and environmental noise into a single pollution burden score.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates greater pollution-related environmental disadvantage
methodology_summary: Direct summation of aligned pollution indicators.

title: Flood Risk from Rivers and Sea
short_description: Likelihood of flooding from rivers and coastal sources.
description: National assessment of flood likelihood from rivers and the sea, accounting for modelled probabilities and flood defences.
indicator: Flood Risk from Rivers and Sea
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (white to blue) blue indicates greater flood risk
methodology_summary: Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning.

title: Flood Risk from Surface Water
short_description: Relative risk of surface water flooding.
description: Identifies areas susceptible to flooding from intense rainfall, overland flow and ponding.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (white to blue) blue indicates greater flood risk
methodology_summary: Environment Agency Risk of Flooding from Surface Water.

title: Projected Increase in Summer Days >28°C
short_description: Projected increase in hot summer days.
description: Estimates changes in the number of summer days exceeding 28°C in the 2030s compared with the 1980s.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates greater projected heat exposure
methodology_summary: Derived from CHESS-SCAPE UKCP18 climate projections.

title: Lack of Access to Greenspace
short_description: Areas lacking adequate access to greenspace.
description: Identifies areas where households do not meet recommended accessible greenspace standards.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates poorer access to greenspace

title: Quality Habitat Deficit
description: Identifies locations where priority habitats are absent from the surrounding landscape.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates greater habitat deficit

title: Nitrogen Dioxide (NO₂)
description: Three-year composite of modelled nitrogen dioxide concentrations highlighting long-term air pollution patterns.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates higher nitrogen dioxide concentrations

title: Environmental Noise
description: Maps relative environmental noise exposure using modelled transport and aircraft noise.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates higher environmental noise exposure
methodology_summary: Strategic noise mapping and modelled datasets.

title: Particulate Matter (PM2.5)
description: Three-year composite of modelled PM2.5 concentrations identifying areas of consistently high and low fine particulate pollution.
higher_values_indicate: Values sorted low to high (green to red) red indicates higher PM2.5 concentrations
